changes.comment: Adds `onSubscriberError` to `createStore`. Reducers, effects, rejections and cascades each had an error hook and event subscribers had `console.error` and nothing else, so an application could not route a failing subscriber to its own error reporting. Subscribers are the seam a decoration is told to use, which makes the gap more visible than it was. Covers a throw and a rejected promise alike; a throwing subscriber still never stops the others.
